title: The KU-barrier exponent 1/(d-1) and the moment crossover r*≈β+1 are the SAME conductor-in-the-denominator obstruction on dual faces (L^∞ vs L^{2r})
evidence: Exact-arithmetic probe scripts/probes/_407_conn/C043_conductor_denominator.py (prize regime n=2^μ proper dyadic subgroup, μ=3..32, real NTT primes q≡1 mod n with q≈n^β, β∈{4,5}, n≪√q) computes both faces' crossovers and the in-tree KU lemma's threshold. THREE separable sub-claims: (B) MOMENT CROSSOVER r*≈β+1 — the smallest r with q·E_r^{char0}(μ_n)<n^{2r}, using the char-0 model E_r=(2r-1)‼·n^r — is CONFIRMED exactly across the whole prize range: for n≥2^12, r*=β+1 verbatim (β=4→5, β=5→6), stable to n=2^128 (separate run). (A) KU L^∞ vacuity at d=n is CONFIRMED (matches in-tree ku_bound_vacuous_at_prize): (n−1)(12+2log₂n) blows to ~3.3e11 at n=2^32 vs budget log₂q≤160; KU_max_d∈{8,9}. (C/D) THE CENTRAL THESIS — 'same conductor-in-denominator, both put n in an exponent q can't beat, cross the budget at the same scale (n left vs β·log n right)' — is REFUTED. The two faces have OPPOSITE structural roles, shown by an exact cancellation analysis: in the moment crossover q·E_r<n^{2r}, n CANCELS (E_r~(2r-1)‼·n^r matched against base n^{2r}), leaving beta+dfl(r)/log₂n<r ⟹ r*=β+1 as n→∞ (residual term dfl(r)/log₂n→0: 0.82 at 2^12 → 0.077 at 2^128) — so n is NOT in a failing exponent, β (a constant) governs, and r*=β+1≈5–6 is small and REACHABLE (it is the ANSWER, not a wall). In the KU face n does NOT cancel: ~n·log n (left) vs β·log n (budget) ⟹ n survives in the exponent denominator of q^{−1/(d−1)} and the tool is genuinely VACUOUS. 'Same scale' also fails numerically: KU SIZE-cap d*∈{8,9} vs moment DEPTH r*∈{5,6} at n=2^32, and the ratio of the two crossovers diverges with n (they are a SIZE and a DEPTH on different axes, as C011 already noted for the broader 3-wall version).
reduced_to: The surviving honest residue is a NEW exact identity, not the claimed unification: the char-0 moment-crossover depth of q·E_r(μ_n)<n^{2r} is EXACTLY r*=β+1 in the prize regime (verified n=2^12..2^128, β∈{4,5}), because the subgroup size n cancels and the field index β=log_n q alone controls the depth. This is a clean reportable fact distinct from C043's thesis. The genuine wall on the moment face is NOT this q·E_r<n^{2r} crossover at all but the p-defect onset r≈2β−3≈3 (CharSumMomentDeepWall.lean), a different mechanism the connection conflates with it.
wall: W-BGK: BGK square-root cancellation for thin μ_n (Paley Graph Conjecture). Both faces are individually vacuous at the prize (KU L^∞ because subgroup size n is in the exponent denominator 1/(d−1); the moment L^{2r} route because the reliable char-0 depth caps at the p-defect onset ≈2β−3 while √(n log m) needs depth ≈log q), and both weld to the SAME open BGK core — but via DIFFERENT structural mechanisms, refuting the 'one conductor-in-denominator invariant' synthesis.
honest_note: C043 got two of its three component facts right (the KU vacuity, already in-tree; and the moment crossover r*=β+1, which I confirm exactly and which is NEW relative to C011's r*_anom=2β−3 — they are different thresholds). The load-bearing UNIFICATION claim is false: only the L^∞/KU face has subgroup-size-n in a failing exponent; in the L^{2r}/moment crossover n cancels and β (constant) determines a small REACHABLE depth, so it is not a 'wall' of the same type and they do not cross 'the same budget at the same scale'. This refines the broader C011 refutation onto the specific KU-vs-moment pairing C043 raised. No closure of the prize core; the BGK wall stands. No Lean attempted (the central claim is false; the two referenced Lean files are each individually correct). Recommend a DISPROOF_LOG entry for the unification thesis while preserving the genuine r*=β+1 crossover identity. Caveat: the moment face uses the char-0 model E_r=(2r-1)‼·n^r (the connection's own model and the established asymptotic); the q·E_r<n^{2r} crossover is a formal threshold, not the operative deep-moment wall.
